title: Madalyonun Sırrı
author: Mehmet Yavuz
description: The Secret of the Medallion is a fast-paced historical adventure inspired by real events and ancient legends. When a young medical student sets out to find a cure for his mother’s mysterious illness, he is drawn into a dangerous quest shaped by shamanic healing, martial arts, and forgotten knowledge. At the heart of the story lies a powerful medallion whose secret traces back to Genghis Khan and reveals a hidden chapter of the 17th-century Ottoman world. As the journey moves across continents and timelines, from modern Turkey to the sacred lands of Ötüken, a group of unlikely allies uncovers the legend of an elixir of immortality and the human cost of pursuing absolute power.
